resolved_conflicts.explanation: FFLOS and firelookout.com say it was built to relieve crowding at the Mount Constitution lookout; WillhiteWeb calls it a replacement for the stone tower on that peak. Both name visitor crowding as the cause; the story gives both wordings.
FFLOS and WillhiteWeb say a private party removed the tower in 1988; the Washington lookouts list says it was sold to a private party and moved. No source says where it went.
Page text says Dorothy Allan; photo captions on the same page say Allen. Story uses the text spelling and notes the captions.

sources.title: Little Summit Lookout Site - Mount Constitution

notes_for_editor: Core dates (built 1966, removed 1988) agree across four sources. The WillhiteWeb page is undated, so 'still visible' reflects when it was written; no recent photo was read. The page's photo captions were not recorded as photos because no image URLs were read. No staffing beyond the first observer was found.
